name: explore
description: Search the Twitter API catalog for routes. The tool makes no network calls. Find tweet search, user lookup, media, monitoring, giveaway, and composition routes.

arguments.name: code
arguments.desc: Bounded filter over spec.endpoints. Each item contains method, path, summary, category, free, parameters, and responseShape.

name: xquik
description: Send confirmed Xquik API requests across 120 MCP routes. Of these, 119 support JSON or text. Search, look up, extract, write, monitor, draw, inspect trends, or compose.

arguments.name: code
arguments.desc: Bounded call to xquik.request(path, options?) for an authenticated Xquik API request.
